pages.text: Health 20, Attack 3, Speed 0.25.$(br)A dark wizard is powerful, and lonely. You keep thinking back to the days when you were still a “player” among friends - and with a little pushing from the black arts, you reproduced beings that look for all the world like players.

As phantoms they are not as sharp as a real player - yet being phantoms, they are cleverer than the common mob: they wield nearly every weapon while sprinting, blocking, sweeping, jump-critting and eating like a player. As a servant, they are your best pick.
Give one an $(item)Arcane Scroll$() and you kindle arcane wisdom in it, turning black magic to its hand.
When a scroll-taught phantom dies, it drops the scroll that stored its data; give that scroll to any unawakened player mob and this arcane master will rise again.
